definitions: The act or process of forming into clusters.
A group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.

In statistics and data mining, the task of grouping a set of objects in such a way that objects in the same group (called a cluster) are more similar to each other than to those in other groups (clusters).
examples: The clustering of stars in the galaxy.
We observed a clustering of cases in the north.
Data clustering is a common technique in machine learning.
